header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the applicant nor any intimation is received. Perusal
body: of the impugned order dated 18.07.2026, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Khipro in Criminal Bail Application No.255/2026 reveals that learned Trial Court properly passed order confirming interim pre-arrest bail of respondents Nos.1 to 3 on the grounds that all the witnesses are relatives of the complainant and no independent person was associated as mashir or witness to the alleged incident. Furthermore, the offence does not fall within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1), Cr.P.C. There is an admitted dispute between the parties regarding the rotation of water; hence, under these circumstances, the possibility of false implication cannot be ruled out. No case for cancellation of bail granted to the respondents is made out. Accordingly, the instant Criminal Miscellaneous Application stands dismissed in limine alongwith listed application(s).
